title: Problems Around Polynomials — Conjecture 4
exact_target: Can a degree-2k sum-of-squares polynomial in any number of variables have more than k to that number of isolated real zeros?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2200007 (AMR-021-0007). CC BY 4.0.

Boris Shapiro, Problems Around Polynomials -- The Good, The Bad and The Ugly, Arnold Mathematical Journal 1 (2015), pp.91--104, Conjecture 4 and its complete preceding definitions. Original question and full discussion.
